endorsements.quote: Although useful in these contexts, it is necessary for clinicians to critically review and validate any computer-generated text before it is used in any clinical setting or research.

It is essential to be transparent about the use of language generation models in research, as this allows others to understand the potential limitations and biases of the generated text and to replicate the research if needed.

unlisted_practices: Retrain language models regularly so they stay up-to-date with the latest medical knowledge.
Put measures to prevent bias in generative AI models in place prospectively rather than retrospectively.
Credit ChatGPT as a tool or resource used in research rather than listing it as an author.
Develop clear guidelines for the responsible use of AI in medical writing.
Be mindful of the impact of AI text generation on employment, including job displacement of medical writers and editors.

screen.reason: Editorial discussing the ethical considerations, risks, and governance recommendations (such as expert review) for using ChatGPT in medical writing.
